exposure: Uterine smooth muscle tumors of uncertain malignant potential (STUMP) diagnosis
outcome: Accuracy rate of intraoperative frozen section diagnosis
cohort: 34 patients diagnosed with uterine smooth muscle tumors of uncertain malignant potential (STUMP) treated at Drum Tower Hospital between January 2009 and December 2021.
finding: The diagnosis of STUMP was difficult, but myomectomy could be an alternative for patients with reproductive needs, particularly those with single lesions, indicating potentially favorable fertility outcomes.
mod_finding: 4 of 9 patients with reproductive aspirations successfully underwent cesarean deliveries.
